# XUruguay

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Gaming retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform and a store in Montevideo. Sells PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox consoles, board and card games, figures and PC accessories. States shipping across the whole country in up to 72 business hours.
